reasons: The status badge shows only "Bounced", which is not one of the five status words. Every time ("Nov 15, 2026, 2:04 AM" and the timeline times) is shown without a time zone. The page uses "Deliveries" and "Mailable" where the product words are Activity and Mailer or email. It also gives no plain verdict or concrete next step: it only tells the reader to open the delivery they are already viewing.
